apps.localizedDescription:
YouTube with Shorts permanently removed.

The NoShortsEver tweak unconditionally strips:
• The Shorts button in the navigation bar
• Shorts shelves and cells in feeds, search results, and channels
• Any Short that still opens is reopened in the normal video player

Minimal build - stock YouTube 21.28.3 plus this one tweak, nothing else.
apps.versionDescription: Minimal build: stock YouTube 21.28.3 with only the NoShortsEver tweak. YTLite removed entirely - crash logs showed YTLite 5.2b3 crashing on this base, and 5.2.2 is the version reported to break playback. Shorts removal is unaffected (NoShortsEver is self-sufficient). No ad-blocking or background playback.
